# Circular Dependency Baseline — 2026-05-16

**Generated by:** `npm run check:cycles` (madge 8.x)
**Config:** `.madgerc` at repo root (excludes `dist/`, `node_modules/`, `.codegraph/`)
**Total cycles found:** 15

This baseline is for tracking — **not all cycles are bugs**. Some are intentional barrel-export patterns (re-export from index that imports types from index). Each entry below has a verdict.

---

## Category A — Barrel-export pattern (acceptable)

The `rule-chain/nodes/index.ts` re-exports every node module; each node module imports type definitions from the same index. Common pattern for plugin registries. Madge flags it but TypeScript handles it correctly because the imports are type-only or used lazily.

```
9)  apps/api/src/modules/rule-chain/nodes/index.ts > nodes/action-nodes.ts
10) apps/api/src/modules/rule-chain/nodes/index.ts > nodes/analytics-nodes.ts
11) apps/api/src/modules/rule-chain/nodes/index.ts > nodes/enrichment-nodes.ts
12) apps/api/src/modules/rule-chain/nodes/index.ts > nodes/external-nodes.ts
13) apps/api/src/modules/rule-chain/nodes/index.ts > nodes/filter-nodes.ts
14) apps/api/src/modules/rule-chain/nodes/index.ts > nodes/transformation-nodes.ts
```

**Action:** none. If the registry shape ever changes, revisit.

---

## Category B — Service-and-submodule cycles (intentional re-export)

`filter-operations.service.ts` is the public facade for the module. After the Step-6 split, each cycle-write operation lives in its own file under `cycle-write/`, but the facade still re-exports them. The submodules import types/helpers from the facade — hence the cycle.

```
3) filter-operations/filter-operations.service.ts > filter-operations/current-state.ts
4) filter-operations/filter-operations.service.ts > filter-operations/cycle-write/advance.ts
5) filter-operations/filter-operations.service.ts > filter-operations/cycle-write/bypass.ts
6) filter-operations/filter-operations.service.ts > filter-operations/cycle-write/start-cycle.ts
7) filter-operations/filter-operations.service.ts > filter-operations/cycle-write/submit-checklist.ts
8) filter-operations/filter-operations.service.ts > filter-operations/cycle-write/terminate-cycle.ts
```

**Action:** investigate during Wave 3.2 (`getCurrentStateImpl` split) — if extracting helpers to a separate `_helpers.ts` file breaks the cycle without changing public API, do it. Otherwise tolerate.
